title: Preselect Vs Select Events And Chrome
description: Separate preselect (rectangle/lasso drag) from committed select; preselect secondary = anchor minus preselect; preselectCancel on Escape; onPreselect/onPreselectCancel events in TS.
summary: Fixed controlled BoardCanvas selection/preselection sync: useLayoutEffect only pushes props to WASM when the controlled snapshot actually changed (refs + boardSelectionSnapshotsEqual / boardPreselectSnapshotsEqual), preventing stale React state from undoing background deselect or single-click pick after invalidate. Exported snapshot equality helpers; added Vitest documenting stale setSelectionIdsSilent behavior. 76 Rust + 73 Vitest board unit tests pass.
